notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes in the English version of the game.

- Translation of the text of the house that is locked.
- Translation of the conversation with Elaine at her grandmother's house.
- Translation of a random dialogue by Elaine and Patricia.
- Text translation of item boxes.

- Bug fix that crashed the game in the dialogue with Zamira.

- Bug fix with Elaine's face changed to Sarissa's.

- Bug fix that player doesn't get Daruk and Shinue when defeating Secret Boss.
